doubted.note: Questions the flow would send to the second look on this solver's word: an answer that is not the key's, another answer the matcher too finds different, a fault reported, or a working far too long for the time allowed. DOE's questions are sound nearly always, so this is the false-alarm rate to plan for.

difficulty.note: The solver's own 1–5 rating, made without seeing the answer. "separation" is the chance that a late-round question is rated harder than an early-round one (ties count half): 0.5 is no better than a coin.
